activity_statements.statement: operates quick-service chicken sandwich restaurants via an Owner-Operator franchise model, closed on Sundays per founding policy
hand-breads chicken for its signature sandwiches and sources fresh produce for salads and fruit cups at each location
selects and supports Owner-Operators of each restaurant location with a focus on community impact and local involvement
provides Remarkable Futures Scholarships to support Team Members pursuing higher education
serves food primarily through drive-thru and in-restaurant counter service at over 3,000 locations in the U.S.

name_reality_gap: none — Chick-fil-A is straightforwardly a chicken quick-service restaurant chain. The franchise model where corporate carefully selects each Owner-Operator is distinctive but not hidden.
extraction_notes: About page was informative on business model and culture. Location count (~3,000+) from widely reported industry knowledge; exact figure not extracted from source. No 10-K available (private company).
